newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
There were 4,800 head confirmed for week to date. The last established price was $67.00 per cwt on Friday.
Monday's packer bids were $65.00-$66.00, with asking prices $67.00-$68.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - None Year Ago - 2,700
Wk to Date - 4,800 Week Ago - 11,500 Year Ago - 45,400
